candidates.transcript_evidence: Are there any common gestures you know which have a unique or surprising meaning in different cultures?
candidates.description: 询问是否知道在不同文化中有独特或令人惊讶含义的常见手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: So what gestures would you use back in Ghana?
candidates.description: 询问在加纳会使用哪些手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: When things are all okay, what would you do?
candidates.description: 询问一切安好时会做什么手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: Yeah, so if you... So when... I don't know whether you get cold weather in Ghana. You probably get it. There's a lot more sun than we get.
candidates.description: 提及加纳可能不冷，阳光更多

candidates.transcript_evidence: So when you're cold, is there a gesture for being cold?
candidates.description: 询问感到冷时是否有对应的手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: And then if you're warm, is there a gesture?
candidates.description: 询问感到热时是否有对应的手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: I know in Spain they do this.
candidates.description: 提及在西班牙人们会做某种手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: So have you... Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. So have you experienced... When you came... When you came to the UK from Ghana, did you experience any misunderstandings because of gestures?
candidates.description: 询问从加纳来英国时是否因手势产生过误解

limitations: 转录中部分句子不完整（如'So if you...'、'So when...'），难以确定完整语义，因此未作为独立候选。
重复的肯定或否定回应（如多个'Yeah'、'No'）仅提取一次作为候选，避免冗余。
